glosses: Having a chemical nature that is harmful to health or lethal if consumed or otherwise entering into the body in sufficient quantities.

examples.text: Tobacco smoke contains many toxic substances.

glosses: Appearing grossly unwell; characterised by serious, potentially life-threatening compromise in the respiratory, circulatory or other body systems.

examples.text: The child appeared toxic on arrival at the hospital.
